name: password-strength-mark
title: Password Strength Mark
description: A wordmark that grades itself: the word STRENGTH renders letter-by-letter, and how many letters are inked versus ghosted encodes password score — typography doubling as a meter without a single bar.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Value Driven Reveal: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
